name: Hannover 96
description: As a traditional club, Hannover 96 has been connecting the region since 1896. The football club stands for community and local ties - values that are also lived in the List.

name: gourmego
description: gourmego supplies natural ice cream raw materials and ice cream ingredients from the NAPURESS® manufactory. Without artificial additives for real artisanal ice cream of the best quality.

name: Bauer Banse
description: Bauer Banse supplies the region with regional products from the farm. Fresh ingredients from the weekly markets - also at Moltkeplatz in the List.

name: Backring Nord
description: Backring Nord is one of the leading specialist wholesalers for bakeries and ice cream parlors. Quality ingredients and reliable delivery for over 100 years.

name: Leibniz
description: Leibniz has stood for baking tradition from Hanover since 1891. The popular butter biscuits perfectly complement ice cream and coffee - regional and proven.

name: Machwitz Kaffee
description: Machwitz Kaffee has been roasting in Hanover since 1883. The oldest roastery in the city - traditional drum roasting for exceptional coffee enjoyment.

name: Waffelfabrik
description: The Waffelfabrik produces high-quality ice cream wafers and cones. Perfect casings for artisanal ice cream creations made in Germany.
